courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Thus far, we covered a lot of important basics you'll need for building Ionic Angular applications.
What we didn't cover thus far is how we can make sure that the app really looks the way we want it to
sure we had a look at the Ionic grid which helps us with positioning items and laying out the page
but what about colors and general settings like the font or the background of our toolbar,
what about all these things, how can we adjust the app to look the way we want it to look?
To answer this question in this module, we'll have a look at styling and theming in Ionic Angular apps
and specifically, we'll dive into which tools Ionic in general gives us when it comes to styling,
how we can set and use a theme in Ionic apps and a theme is things like the colors, the font and so on,
how we can use CSS variables to our advantage and what CSS variables actually are and how
custom CSS or in this project actually Sass but doesn't really matter,
styles fit into this whole big picture.
